Workshop and lecture material I have developed and taught, all open and free to reuse or adapt. Most come with a written walkthrough, slides, and the source repository, so they can be run without me. I am a [certified Carpentries instructor](https://carpentries.org/) and have run these at conferences, research bazaars, and universities.
